card.name: Words just before kidney-related terms
card.fires_on: Short linking or modifying words right before kidney or renal terms in drug-label text, such as 'known' before nephrotoxic, 'chronic' before renal disease, or 'decrease' before renal blood flow. It also fires on a few dose-table pieces.

modes.label: Word before renal term
modes.description: A verb or adjective that leads into a kidney-related phrase such as renal blood flow, nephrotoxic drugs or renal disease.
modes.example: Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAID) Clinical Impact: NSAID<< decrease>> renal blood flow, resulting

modes.label: Dose and impairment wording
modes.description: Pieces of dosing-adjustment text, such as a preposition before a patient group or a number in a ratio or renal-function range.

card.writes: It seems to push toward kidney-related continuations and away from nationality words, with a weak pull toward some Chinese tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a kidney-related term in label text, such as 'known' before nephrotoxic drugs.
